english.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice when an amount or frequency is too high.
Use this for a quantity that exceeds what is needed, especially when translating “too much” or “too many.”

examples.english: I've been eating excessive amounts of takeout lately, and my stomach is often upset.
examples.traditional: 呢排食咗太多外賣，個肚成日唔舒服。
examples.jyutping: ni1 paai4 sik6 zo2 taai3 do1 ngoi6 maai6 go3 tou5 seng4 jat6 m4 syu1 fuk6

examples.english: There is too much food on the table, and some of it is superfluous.
examples.traditional: 枱面啲餸太多喇，有啲係多餘嘅。
examples.jyutping: ci4 min6 di1 sung3 taai3 do1 laa3 jau5 di1 hai6 do1 jyu4 ge3
